title: The universal valued Abelian groups of Niemiec are Lévy, strongly exotic, extremely amenable, and $\mathbb{G}_r(0)$ is generically monothetic
summary: We prove various properties of the universal valued Abelian groups $\mathbb{G}_r(N)$ constructed by Niemiec, for $r\in\{1,\infty\}$ and $N\in\{0,2,3,\ldots\}$. First we show that the completion of $Γ_0=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\mathbb{Q}/\mathbb{Z}$ (for $N=0$) or $Γ_N=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb{N}}\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ (for $N\geq 2$) with respect to a generic invariant metric, bounded by $1$ when $r=1$, is isometrically group-isomorphic to $\mathbb{G}_r(N)$, recovering a result of Doucha in the case when $r=\infty $ and $N=0$. This confirms an expectation of Doucha for the group $Γ_N$. We…
